reason: 2.1.1 builds the group focus-ring tokens in _styles.scss with var() substituted on :root, so a nested data-theme island inherits the page scheme's ring color. With light-dark() the token resolves per element, so the island gets its own scheme's color.
Consequence of group-island-focus-ring-tokens: the [role=group] and [role=search] focus ring inside a nested data-theme island uses the island's scheme color instead of the page's.
